summary: Chinese-language LLM course for developers, translating and reproducing 11 of Andrew Ng's courses, from prompting to RAG and fine-tuning.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: LLM Cookbook is a Chinese learning guide from Datawhale for developers starting with large language models. It translates and reproduces the code of 11 of Andrew Ng's LLM short courses, covering prompt engineering, building systems on the ChatGPT API, LangChain apps and chatting with your own data, then optional courses on Gradio, evaluation, fine-tuning, semantic search, advanced retrieval with Chroma, advanced RAG, and LangChain agents. It also adds Chinese prompts that work about as well as the English ones.
sixtySeconds.problem: Many top LLM courses are only in English. This gives Chinese-speaking developers translated lessons and runnable notebooks in a recommended order.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Use it for a structured Chinese path through well-known LLM development courses, with runnable bilingual notebooks.
requirements: At least one LLM API key, ideally OpenAI

overview: Read the required courses online at datawhalechina.github.io/llm-cookbook or download the PDF from the releases page.
Run the bilingual notebooks in the content folder; they are the most up to date.
Start with the four required courses in order, then pick optional ones. Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
